name: turn-timeline
description: A live side pane listing every tool call of the current reply, with when it started, how long it took and how it ended

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it docks once the window is wide enough); off, open it with /timeline

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: How wide the pane opens when docked beside the conversation (30 to 120); a width you drag it to wins

paneRows.title: Pane height (rows)
paneRows.description: How tall the pane opens when shown above the prompt (5 to 40); a height you drag it to wins
